articles.title: There's an election next month: State of Crypto
articles.snippet: Congress is gone from Washington for the final pre-election recess, and it's time to take stock of what's going on ahead of November.

articles.title: El Salvador receives $138 million from IMF after Bitcoin waivers granted
articles.snippet: Efforts will continue to reduce the state’s involvement in Bitcoin-related activities and to strengthen crypto‑asset regulation and governance, the IMF said.
